Hello!

This Canny board is for bug reports, for user support or assistance with lost persistence data submit a user support request within 30 days of the incident with world + timestamps to https://vrch.at/support in a ticket.

The VRChat QA team or community members on this board cannot fix your account and cannot restore lost persistence data, when the user support team can.

For future posts, please ask questions on the [VRChat Ask](https://ask.vrchat.com/) forums.

Description

lost Data in project aincard During one of my playthroughs on Project Ancard, my entire save data got wiped when I went into a specific area, and it one-shotted me and my party. It also wouldn't let us save our save data before we went into the dungeon that they just recently added. At the moment, we do not know what to do about this situation. Is there possibly a way for us to get our save data back?

Reproduction Steps

During one of my playthroughs on Project Ancard, my entire save data got wiped when I went into a specific area, and it one-shotted me and my party. It also wouldn't let us save our save data before we went into the dungeon that they just recently added. At the moment, we do not know what to do about this situation. Is there possibly a way for us to get our save data back?

- Frequency: Once
